ETH.note: Only refugee ID cards with a Fayda number are mentioned, with no authentication service stated.
No link between civil register and ID stated.
The vital registration system is not described as digital.
No count or share of the population holding a national ID.
Nothing on who operates or maintains the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.
Biometric checks are given only as the aim of the Fayda number, and no enrolment or issuance is stated.

facts.fact: UNHCR reports that only 12 percent of 576,000 refugee children in Ethiopia were registered in the vital registration system as of August 2024.
The Refugees and Returnees Service previously announced an initiative to issue refugees and asylum seekers digital ID cards carrying a Fayda number from the National ID Program.

ETH.note: Nothing on how local offices make the record.
